michigan_standard_targets.name: ANALYZE IN CONTEXT
michigan_standard_targets.statement: Understand, analyze, and describe the arts in their historical, social, and cultural contexts.

michigan_standard_targets.name: ANALYZE AND MAKE CONNECTIONS
michigan_standard_targets.statement: Recognize, analyze, and describe connections among the arts; between the arts and other disciplines; between the arts and everyday life.

name_similarity_note: Connecting / ANALYZE AND MAKE CONNECTIONS share 'connect-'. Recorded, and deliberately NOT relied on: the shared root points at Standard 5 alone and would hide the Standard 4 half.
referent_resolution: Spans more than one Michigan standard; choosing between them requires reading the lesson, which is out of scope.
subject: arts-and-music
text_claim_reason: NCAS process vocabulary; occurs zero times as a capitalised name in either held Michigan arts document (R4-ARTS-1).
warrant: The two halves of NCAS Connecting land on two different Michigan standards. ART.M.V.3.2 ('Observe and identify cross-curricular connections within the 3rd grade curriculum.') is Standard 5. ART.M.IV.3.2 ('Describe how elements of music are used in examples from world cultures, using music performed and presented in 3rd grade.') is Standard 4.

michigan_standard_targets.name: CREATE
michigan_standard_targets.statement: Apply skills and knowledge to create in the arts.

name_similarity_note: Creating / CREATE share a root. Recorded, not relied on: the warrant is the expectation text.
referent_resolution: Maps to exactly one Michigan standard (II) under a documented, reversible rule warranted by Michigan's own Grade 3 expectation text.
subject: arts-and-music
text_claim_reason: NCAS process vocabulary; occurs zero times as a capitalised name in either held Michigan arts document (R4-ARTS-1).

michigan_standard_targets.name: PERFORM
michigan_standard_targets.statement: Apply skills and knowledge to perform in the arts.

name_similarity_note: Performing / PERFORM share a root. Recorded, not relied on.
referent_resolution: Maps to exactly one Michigan standard (I) under a documented, reversible rule warranted by Michigan's own Grade 3 expectation text.
subject: arts-and-music
text_claim_reason: NCAS process vocabulary; occurs zero times as a capitalised name in either held Michigan arts document (R4-ARTS-1).
warrant: Michigan Standard 1 is 'Apply skills and knowledge to perform in the arts', and its Grade 3/4 expectations are performance-realization outcomes.

caveat: Michigan Standard 3 is not a pure analogue at the expectation level: ART.D.III.3.4 ('Demonstrate the ability to create a dance study for presentation to peers.') is a creation-and-presentation outcome filed under ANALYZE. The standard-level mapping holds; the expectation-level partition does not, which is one more reason rule R4-ARTS-4 refuses to assign a code.
